newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: TT Resources shares debut at 4.98 rgt.
newsitem.headline: TT Resources shares debut at 4.98 rgt.

text.p: Shares of TT Resources Bhd made their stock market debut at 4.98 ringgit against an offer price of 2.50.
The restaurant operator offered 6.22 million vendor shares for its listing on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
At 0230 GMT, the stock was at 4.90 ringgit, after trading between 4.70 and 5.0 ringgit.
Volume was 2.12 million shares, the market's most active in the late-morning trade.
The company forecast a net profit of 4.72 million ringgit or earnings per share (EPS) of 12.5 cents for the year ended September 31, 1997.
It recorded net profit of 4.13 million ringgit or EPS of 10.9 cents for the 1996 financial year.
